# Opinion and order on the motion to dismiss

The Ashmoor County Probation Department, HMRC, the Federal Election Commission and the 9th Cir. applied the Gaming Act 2031 to ⟦ORG|Quillon Freight LLC⟧.

The State of Ashmoria, the United States and the Town of Brindle (Illinois) sued; Federal, State, and local taxes apply to ⟦ORG|Quillon Freight LLC⟧ of Boston.

The claimants also rely on the Biometric Information Privacy Act, 740 ILCS 14/1 (“BIPA”), and on the First Amendment. The Department of Justice filed a statement of interest. BIPA does not reach ⟦ORG|Georgia-Quillon Paper LLC⟧, a citizen of Massachusetts, which the Town of Plymouth also named.

The motion is granted in part.
